chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch 385: Ji Ning Meets a Celestial Immortal and Gains the Eight-Nine Arcane Art
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning fails to breach a treasure trial, meets a mysterious Celestial Immortal, and returns to Mount Innerheart to claim the supreme divine ability, the Eight-Nine Arcane Art!
og_title: Desolate Era Chapter 385: The Eight-Nine Arcane Art
og_description: Humiliated by a mysterious Celestial Immortal, Ji Ning returns to Mount Innerheart. His new disciple discovers their master's terrifyingly powerful sect, and Ji Ning obtains the legendary defensive divine ability.
twitter_title: DE 385: Celestial Immortal Roadblock & Divine Ability Reward!
twitter_description: Ji Ning gets humbled in a treasure trial, but returns home to a gift that changes everything—the Eight-Nine Arcane Art. Plus, a new disciple gets a world-shattering welcome.

lore_anchors.definition: A core Xianxia trope where a cultivator's pure technique and Dao comprehension are tested against a mirror match or a restrictive environment, often banning divine abilities or formations.

The supreme divine ability beneath the True God level, trained by mastering nine cycles of body refinement; provides passive indestructibility without consuming divine power but requires enormous treasure resources to advance.

A visible aura of accumulated good deeds; the taller the light, the purer the cultivator's soul and the more favored they are by the Heavenly Dao. Ji Ning’s three feet contrasts with his disciple’s three hundred zhang.
A high-grade consumable treasure that allows a cultivator to instantly teleport across vast distances, often used as a life-saving escape tool.
